implementedFoundation: ImpactPreviewRevision freezes exact Plan, Brief, EvidenceBundle, EvalContract, ResponsibilityPlan and StageTemplate refs
optional ModelRoute, RuntimePolicy, Capability and mutable binding refs enter a server-owned dependency snapshot
eight impact dimensions distinguish measured, estimated and unknown; known values require source refs and cutoff
freeze and start revalidate dependency snapshot and mutable binding versions
ActionProposal can bind an exact ImpactPreview ref and drift then blocks approval and execution lease
W2-D3 strict SDK, UI and real-tenant fail-closed empty browser evidence are integrated at m1

findings.finding: accountRef is modeled but every supplied account is recorded as authority_unavailable and blocked; there is no exact controlled account resolver.
accountRef and capabilityRef are optional, so an otherwise ready Preview can omit the external account and capability required for a W5 Action.

ActionProposal binds the Preview ref but does not prove that its ActionType, CapabilityBinding, account, Adapter, risk policy and budget policy are the same exact dependencies assessed by the Preview.
legacy-compatible Action proposals without an ImpactPreview remain approvable and leasable; W5 allowlisted external actions need a server-side mandatory-preview policy.

impact values can carry evidence refs but are caller supplied; no exact Adapter dry-validation receipt proves account permission, provider quota, capacity, estimated cost, reversibility or reconcile mode.
Preview has no exact AdapterRevision, ActionTypeRevision, RiskPolicyRevision, BudgetPolicyRevision or KillPolicyRevision refs.
mutable CapabilityBinding snapshot checks version and active status only; it does not snapshot health, referenced capability hash, quota/network policy, secret/account binding or provider readiness.
W4-03 already proved that Eval publication and release-gate revocation are not reliably propagated through frozen Preview revalidation.
ProductionStartDecision authorizes canonical TaskRun creation only; it is not an Action ExecutionLease and cannot authorize an external provider side effect.
org-org/dev-project has 0 Preview and 0 StartDecision; W2-D browser evidence is correctly fail-closed but provides no positive W5 account or Action proof.
